notes:
### Research Notes: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API)

#### **What the product does**
WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) allows businesses to communicate with customers at scale using the WhatsApp network. It is a RESTful API hosted by Meta that supports sending and receiving text, media (images, documents), interactive messages (buttons, lists), and "WhatsApp Flows" for structured data collection. It is designed for medium-to-large businesses to integrate messaging into CRMs, customer support tools, and automated workflows.
*   **Source:** [Meta Documentation](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api) - "The WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API enables you to programmatically message and call on WhatsApp."

#### **Authentication Methods**
The API uses Meta's Graph API authentication framework.
*   **bearer_token**: Used for all API requests. Developers can generate a **Temporary Access Token** (valid for 24 hours) for testing or a **Permanent Access Token** by creating a "System User" in the Meta Business Suite.
*   **oauth2**: For multi-tenant integration platforms (like Composio), the **Embedded Signup** flow is used. This is built on "Facebook Login for Business," where a client authenticates via a popup, and the platform receives an authorization code to exchange for an access token to manage the client's WhatsApp Business Account (WABA).
*   **Source:** [Meta Documentation](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/embedded-signup) - "Embedded Signup is an authentication and authorization interface... It then grants your app access to these assets."

#### **Credential Acquisition & Cost**
*   **Access:** `self_serve_free` (for sandbox/testing); `approval_required` (for production).
*   **Developer Credentials:** Any developer with a Meta account can create a "Business" app at `developers.facebook.com`, add the "WhatsApp" product, and immediately get a **Test Number** and **Temporary Access Token** for free.
*   **Production Approval:** To use a real phone number, the business must undergo **Meta Business Verification** (taking 2–7 days) and comply with WhatsApp's Commerce Policy.
*   **Cost:** 
    *   **Free Tier:** Historically, the first 1,000 service conversations per month were free.
    *   **New Model (2025/2026):** Meta is shifting to per-message pricing based on category (Marketing, Utility, Authentication, Service). **Service messages** (replies within a 24-hour window) remain free until **October 1, 2026**.
*   **Source:** [Meta Pricing](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/pricing) - "Effective July 1, 2025, Meta charges on a per-message basis... Service messages... are free until October 1, 2026."

#### **API Style & Features**
*   **Style:** REST (Graph API).
*   **Breadth:** Comprehensive; covers messaging, template management, media uploads, phone number registration, and real-time analytics.
*   **OpenAPI Spec:** Meta maintains an official repository for its API specifications.
    *   **Source:** [GitHub - facebook/meta-openapi](https://github.com/facebook/meta-openapi) - "This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Meta APIs."
*   **Webhooks:** Supported for incoming messages, message status updates (sent, delivered, read), and account quality changes.
*   **Sandbox:** A "Test Number" is provided in the Meta Developer Dashboard for immediate testing without a real phone number.

#### **MCP Servers**
*   **Official:** Meta hosts a remote MCP server.
    *   **Source:** [Meta for Developers](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/mcp) - "The WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server is a remote server... Endpoint: `https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools`."
*   **Community:** Several community-built servers exist, such as `FredShred7/whatsapp-mcp-server` (Official Cloud API based) and `lharries/whatsapp-mcp` (Unofficial Web-based).

#### **Buildability Verdict**
*   **Verdict:** `ready_now`
*   **Main Blocker:** None. The platform provides a free sandbox and a well-documented REST API. For multi-tenant use, the "Embedded Signup" flow is the standard, though it requires the platform to be a verified Meta Business.
*   **Source:** [Meta Developer Hub](https://whatsappbusiness.com/developers/developer-hub/) - "Start building within minutes and send engaging, timely, high-quality messages... get started quickly and test for free."
